“开机了？”霖多多的声音充满困倦，边说还下意识的又在那瓣超弹捏捏乐上按了两把。

上官程像被烫到一样猛地弹开，退到帐篷边缘，脊背贴着篷布。微弱的夜灯在他脸上投下明暗交错的光影，那上面的表情——羞恼、惊愕、窘迫——清晰地写满了整张脸。

“你……你怎么醒了？”

声音发紧，像被人掐住了喉咙。

“还怪我咯？”霖多多打了个呵欠，一脸无语的看着他。

“我睡得正香，突然梦见一头熊朝我扑来，死死压住，怎么推都起不来……差点没给我压死！”

“我……我倒下，还压到了你？”上官程听到此话微微蹙眉。他分明记得自己迁魂前摆了个很稳当的坐姿——盘腿而坐，背脊挺直，双手放在膝盖上，绝对是不受外力影响的标准姿态。无论如何都不可能倒下。

除非……有人动了他。

他眼神微眯看向霖多多，眸中带着几分审视。

霖多多被这一眼盯的飘忽。

她有些心虚。

其实根本不是上官程倒下压到了她。而是她自己睡相不好，翻到上官程身边将人勾到了自己怀里，结果反被压了个结实！

霖多多担心对方品出猫腻，迅速转移话题：“你说你怎么回事？保证好了不会再出现死机的情况，怎么又死机？”

“我……”上官程审视的目光被这声质问扰乱。

“抱歉。”他垂眸，试图寻找一种合理的解释，“就当是……一种bug吧。当我的身体（本体）出现某种状况时，就需要进入这种状态进行修复。下次我再出现这种情况时，会提前告诉你。不用太担心，小毛病而已。”

“真没事？”

“真的，放心。”

“那行吧。”听上官程如此笃定，霖多多安心了，翻了个身继续睡觉。

夜灯的光很微弱，上官程倚在冰凉的帐篷边沿，将后续事宜尽数传音交代给常野。

帐篷里重新安静下来，父亲方才的话再度回荡耳畔，那敷衍又疏离的语气、不带半分温情的回应，让他心情燥郁不堪。

以往产生这种情绪时，他会通过极端的方式纾解。例如暴力，亦或是杀戮。让敌人的血浇灭那团火，让骨头碎裂的声音盖过心底的嘈杂。那些方式残忍、直接、有效——在身为上官家大少爷时，亦或是在快穿局的一千个世界里，他试过无数次。

可如今，他困在此处，那些惯用的宣泄方式根本无法施展。

这团火找不到出口，就开始反噬自己。他想到了另一种偏执方法——疼痛。

睡前霖多多给他下达了强制指令——“进来跟我一起睡”。

一旦他试图踏出帐篷半步，即刻便会触发强电击惩罚。那是直击灵魂的痛楚，像是亿万根淬了冰的细针，同时扎入魂魄深处，能让他痛不欲生，也能让他忘记此刻的燥郁。

"Is it on?" Lin Duoduo's voice was full of sleepiness, and as he spoke, he subconsciously pressed two more times on the super-elastic pincher.

Shangguan Cheng jumped away as if he had been burned and retreated to the edge of the tent, his back pressed against the tarpaulin.The weak night light cast alternating light and dark shadows on his face, and the expressions on it - shame, surprise, and embarrassment - were clearly written all over his face.

"You...how did you wake up?"

His voice was tight, as if someone had strangled his throat.

"You still blame me?" Lin Duoduo yawned and looked at him speechlessly.

"I was sleeping soundly, and suddenly I dreamed that a bear was rushing towards me, and it pinned me down so hard that it couldn't get up no matter how hard I pushed... I almost died from being crushed!"

"I...I fell down and hit you?" Shangguan Cheng frowned slightly when he heard this.He clearly remembered that he had a very stable sitting posture before moving to the soul - sitting cross-legged, with his back straight and his hands on his knees. It was definitely a standard posture that was not affected by external forces.It is impossible to fall down no matter what.

Unless... someone touched him.

He narrowed his eyes slightly and looked at Lin Duoduo with a bit of scrutiny in his eyes.

Lin Duoduo was stunned by this stare.

She felt a little guilty.

In fact, it wasn't Shangguan Cheng who crushed her at all.It was because she was not sleeping well, so she rolled over to Shangguan Cheng and pulled him into her arms, only to be crushed!

Lin Duoduo was worried that the other party's product was fishy, so he quickly changed the subject: "What did you say happened to you? I promised that it wouldn't crash again, so why did it crash again?"

"I..." Shangguan Cheng's scrutinizing gaze was disturbed by this question.

"Sorry." He lowered his eyes, trying to find a reasonable explanation, "Just think of it as... a bug. When my body (body) encounters a certain situation, I need to enter this state for repair. The next time this happens to me, I will tell you in advance. Don't worry too much, it's just a minor problem."

"Is everything okay?"

"Really, don't worry."

"That's alright." Lin Duoduo felt relieved when Shangguan Cheng was so sure, turned over and continued to sleep.

The light of the night light was very weak. Shangguan Cheng leaned on the edge of the cold tent and relayed all the follow-up matters to Chang Ye.

The tent became quiet again, and his father's words just now echoed in his ears again. The perfunctory and distant tone and the response without any warmth made him feel depressed.

In the past, when he had this kind of emotion, he would use extreme methods to relieve it.For example, violence, or killing.Let the enemy's blood extinguish the fire, and let the sound of broken bones cover the noise in your heart.Those methods were cruel, direct, and effective - he had tried them countless times when he was the eldest son of the Shangguan family, or in the thousand worlds of the Quick Travel Bureau.

But now, he is trapped here, and those usual methods of catharsis cannot be used at all.

This fire couldn't find an outlet and began to bite back on itself.He thought of another method of paranoia - pain.

Before going to bed, Lin Duoduo gave him a mandatory instruction - "Come in and sleep with me."

Once he attempts to take half a step out of the tent, he will immediately be punished with a strong electric shock.It was a pain that directly hit the soul, like billions of fine needles quenched with ice, piercing into the depths of the soul at the same time, making him miserable and making him forget the depression at the moment.
